text: C_82 < 0.2534449, an upper bound on the essential minimum of the Zhang–Zagier height exhibited by R. Pinho's limit-point construction with 7 denominator and 31 numerator factors (deg Q = 999,999,992) [Pin26].

source.what: the registry's 82a page at 46dbf036 (the upper-bounds table row [Pin26])
source.quote: | 0.2534449\* | [Pin26] | Doche's limit-point construction [Doc01b] on the factor library of [Gri26] and [Epi26], adding $P\_7$ to the denominator and 25 new numerator factors found by LP-dual-weighted lattice reduction (LLL), with all multiplicities and exponents re-optimised by a linear program ($\deg Q = 999999992$).

domain.decoder: the key denominator: 7 factors R_j, each an integer coefficient list coeffs (leading coefficient first) with an integer multiplicity m_j; the key numerator: 31 factors S_i, each an integer coefficient list coeffs with a rational exponent q_rational = q_i > 0 (all 31 active); D = Σ_j m_j deg R_j = 999,999,992; the keys description, target, grid, numeric_unverified and credits are the claimant's statements, not the domain

g.named: Doche's limit-point bound B = ( log M(Q∘T) + ∫_0^1 max(0, Σ_i q_i log|S_i∘T(e^{2πit})| − Σ_j m_j log|R_j∘T(e^{2πit})|) dt ) / D with T(z) = z(1 − z), Q = Π_j R_j^{m_j}, D = Σ_j m_j deg R_j and M the Mahler measure, enclosed by sound arithmetic once the hypotheses of Doche's theorem hold exactly: integer factors with the denominators monic up to sign, Σ_i q_i deg S_i < D, gcd(S_i, R_j) = 1 for q_i > 0, and every root of every composed factor isolated

reference: the bar is the registry's printed 0.2534449 taken exactly, with the strict relation that the registry's README line ($C_{82} < 0.2534449*$), the 82a page's [Pin26] reference line (Certificate and checkers for C82 < 0.2534449) and the claimant's own title print; the quantity is the construction's limit-point bound B, enclosed by the record at [0.2534446872487138, 0.2534446875145076] (B.js; B.py agrees), whose upper end is below the bar by 2.1e-7 — not the row's quoted certified 0.2534446873…, which lies inside the record's enclosure, nor the file's numeric_unverified; the record's claim string writes <=, the object states the printed <, and the enclosure decides both the same way
hypotheses: Doche's theorem [Doc01b] (the limit-point argument: U^n − W^n over the primes, Jensen's formula, coprimality), also proved in the claimant [Pin26]'s README: for integer factors with the stated hypotheses, infinitely many distinct algebraic numbers have h_Z <= B, so C_82 <= B (read, not re-derived)
the definition on the 82a page: C_82 is the supremum of the H for which {α : h_Z(α) <= H} is finite, h_Z(α) = h(α) + h(1 − α) (read)
the integrand is symmetric under t → 1 − t (real coefficients), so the integral over [0, 1/2] doubled is the integral over [0, 1] (read; the record's limit)
falsifier: the enclosure of B computed from the pinned factors has its lower end at or above 2534449/10000000 (REFUTED), or straddles it (REFUSED)

a hypothesis of Doche's theorem fails on the pinned factors: a non-integer coefficient or a non-rational exponent, Σ q_i deg S_i >= D, a numerator factor sharing a root with a denominator factor, a denominator factor not monic up to sign, or a root that cannot be isolated (the deciders refuse)
